findings.claim: Practice question 2 mark scheme opens 'Award 1 mark for: contains cell sap ...'.
findings.truth: Rewritten as 'Contains cell sap / keeps the cell turgid / supports the cell structure. [1 mark]'.
findings.evidence: House validator: the rubric phrase 'Award N mark(s) for' is a banned string in any lesson field.

findings.claim: Calorimetry: 'c is the specific heat capacity of water (4.2 J g<sup>1</sup> °C<sup>1</sup>)'.
findings.truth: The negative signs have been lost from the indices. It should read 4.2 J g−1 °C−1, which renders as 'J g minus one degC minus one'. As written it renders 'J g1 degC1', which is a different (and meaningless) unit.
findings.evidence: Settled value: the specific heat capacity of water is 4200 J/kg °C = 4.2 J g−1 °C−1.

findings.claim: 'glucose diffuses from the gut into blood cells'.
findings.truth: Glucose is absorbed from the gut into the blood (the plasma), not into blood cells. A student who wrote 'into blood cells' would not be credited.
findings.evidence: Spec 1.15 (transport into and out of cells); settled physiology.

findings.claim: Osmosis core practical: 'The concentration at which there is no change in mass is the water potential of the potato cells.'
findings.truth: A concentration is not a water potential. At that point the solution and the potato cells have the SAME water potential. Rewritten to say so.
findings.evidence: Spec 1.16 / 1.17 (osmosis in potatoes, percentage change in mass); category error.

findings.claim: The whole 'Food Tests (Triple Only)' section, including the four food tests and calorimetry, sits inside <div class="higher-only">.

findings.truth: Missing: 2.12B (limits on treating brain and nervous system damage — spinal injuries and brain tumours; L3 is titled '... and the Brain' and stops after CT/PET), 3.1B and 3.2B (advantages and disadvantages of asexual and sexual reproduction), 3.18B (how sex-linked disorders are inherited — only glanced at in L4 for colour blindness), 4.13B (fertilisers and biological control), 5.11B (detecting and identifying plant diseases), 5.19B (cross-sectional area of a clear zone using pi r squared). findings.claim: ABO alleles are written in plain-text fields as caret notation: 'I^A I^O', 'I^B I^O'.
findings.truth: Not LaTeX and not wrong, but it is markup leaking into a plain-text field. Unicode superscripts would render inconsistently across fonts, so no edit is proposed.
findings.evidence: Plain-text fields use unicode; the *_html fields in the same lesson correctly use <sup>.

findings.claim: The Key Fact on human non-specific defences lists skin, the mucus-cilia escalator, lysozyme and the inflammatory response.

summary: The unit's systematic fault is that <div class="higher-only"> has been used to mean 'separate science only': nine gates wrapped Biology-only but both-tier content, including a core practical (aseptic technique and antibiotic discs), vaccination, the whole of the eye, food tests and Mendel, hiding them from every Foundation student. Nine wrappers removed, two narrowed to the genuinely Higher-tier part, and 21 questions, checks and flashcards on the content that stays gated tagged '(Higher tier)'. Also fixed: six 9-mark practice questions re-banded to 6 (this board sets no 9-mark question), a broken specific heat capacity unit, glucose absorbed 'into blood cells', and a concentration described as a water potential. One ADJUDICATE on Biology-only Paper 1 statements the unit omits. The spec markdown has lost its bold, so every tier ruling rests on knowledge of 1BI0 plus the line-wrap width evidence in the file, not on the file's own marking.
